title: #smallpoems The Thoughts scream through my ears searching, looking eternally reasons sought lost in thought blinded by truth I grasp firmly to reality
summary: #smallpoems The Thoughts scream through my ears searching, looking eternally reasons sought lost in thought blinded by truth I grasp firmly to reality so much concentration...so much pain every social situation serves as a mental abomination
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
The Thoughts
scream through my ears
searching, looking
eternally
reasons sought
lost in thought
blinded by truth
I grasp firmly
to reality
so much concentration...so much
pain
every social situation serves as a
mental abomination
